text: List view: load all phases up front so columns never show unloaded children as empty
description: Bug: after reload, column N+1 only shows children of the selected parent; siblings' children render as empty placeholders until navigating in column N. Cause: buildColumnEntries cannot distinguish 'children not loaded' from 'no children', and ensureColumnNeighborhoodLoaded's termination checks count those fake placeholders as content. Fix (step 1 of list-view loading cleanup): load all phases in one phase.list call (34 phases / 140KB), keep synced via onUpdate subscription, drop per-parent lazy/neighborhood loading, and memoize column entries. Step 2 (selection-state consolidation into an id path + single resolveSelectionPath) is a follow-up.

status.comment: Implemented in c915155. Awaiting Felix's confirmation that reload in column N+1 now shows all phases.

valueRationale: User-reported list view bug; phases silently missing after reload undermines trust in the main navigation surface.
reflection: Commit c915155. loadProject loads all phases via one phase.list call (falls back to lazy loading on error); ensureColumnNeighborhoodLoaded now loads every parent group of a column in parallel instead of the height-driven loop that counted fake placeholders as content; column entries built once in a cached phaseColumns getter; Column.vue selectable-index lookup is O(1); removed dead ensureColumnsLoaded/ensureVisibleColumnSelections/height estimators. Verification: new regression test (10-child first parent group, cursor on last child) fails on HEAD~1 with a placeholder for root-b, passes now; frontend 234/234 tests, vue-tsc clean. Live app on :4000 with v7 project: 34/34 phases loaded, columns 4/8/13/9 phases, 0 placeholders under parents that actually have children. Follow-up not done: selection-state consolidation (index+id+lastSelected triple, duplicated repairSelectionRight/realignVisibleColumnsFrom/restore loops).
